promotion_rule: A registry entry is a research input only. Promotion to a selector requires a separately versioned frozen policy, causal acquisition, prospective screening, and independent replication. Economic claims require execution-appropriate evidence.

signals.definition: Signed early flow normalized by event reserve inside the frozen causal evidence window.
signals.coverage_requirement: complete frozen pump_launch 5s feature snapshot
signals.adversarial_risk: Can be inflated by concentrated or coordinated flow.
signals.promotion_gate: No new threshold may be inferred from observed outcomes without a new preregistration.
signals.notes: Frozen Launch Burst baseline uses >=0.08. That threshold is not portable to other chains without semantic parity and fresh preregistration.

signals.definition: Number of causally observed market events in the evidence window.
signals.coverage_requirement: complete frozen pump_launch 5s feature snapshot
signals.adversarial_risk: Event spam can mimic participation breadth.
signals.promotion_gate: Independent prospective replication after the frozen screening run.
signals.notes: Sniper V1 preregisters >=5; do not retune from screening outcomes.

signals.definition: Directional quality of early signed flow rather than raw activity alone.
signals.coverage_requirement: complete frozen pump_launch 5s feature snapshot
signals.adversarial_risk: Short coordinated bursts may look directionally clean.
signals.promotion_gate: Independent prospective replication after the frozen screening run.
signals.notes: Sniper V1 preregisters >=0.50.

signals.definition: Share of events with usable wallet identity in the causal feature snapshot.
signals.coverage_requirement: >=80% in Sniper V1
signals.adversarial_risk: High event-count coverage can still hide unidentified high-volume flow.
signals.promotion_gate: Keep paired with gross-flow coverage; independent replication required.
signals.notes: Coverage control, not proof of organic demand.

signals.definition: Share of gross flow attributable to identified wallets.
signals.coverage_requirement: >=80% in Sniper V1
signals.adversarial_risk: Missing flow can mask concentration if not treated conservatively.
signals.promotion_gate: Independent prospective replication required.
signals.notes: Guards against event-count identity coverage being misleading.

signals.definition: Distinct causally observed BUY-side wallets inside the evidence window.
signals.coverage_requirement: wallet identity coverage sufficient for interpretation
signals.adversarial_risk: Sybil wallets can manufacture apparent breadth.
signals.promotion_gate: Must be interpreted with concentration/entity-quality signals and independently replicated.
signals.notes: Sniper V1 preregisters >=3; intentionally counts buyers rather than all participants.

signals.definition: Conservative dominant-wallet share where all unidentified gross flow is assigned to the largest identified wallet.
signals.coverage_requirement: identified wallet flow plus explicit unidentified-flow accounting
signals.adversarial_risk: Multiple related wallets can evade single-wallet concentration checks.
signals.promotion_gate: Add entity clustering only after causal graph evidence is available; independent replication required.
signals.notes: Sniper V1 preregisters <=60%; missing flow cannot make the token look more organic.

signals.definition: Share of causal events with usable transaction identity.
signals.coverage_requirement: >=80% in Sniper V1
signals.adversarial_risk: Identity coverage alone does not establish transaction independence.
signals.promotion_gate: Independent prospective replication required.
signals.notes: Used with unique transaction count.

signals.definition: Distinct transaction identities causally observed in the evidence window.
signals.coverage_requirement: transaction identity coverage sufficient for interpretation
signals.adversarial_risk: One entity can generate many transactions.
signals.promotion_gate: Independent prospective replication required.
signals.notes: Sniper V1 preregisters >=3.

signals.definition: Past-only history of the deployer/dev across prior launches, sells and rug-like outcomes.
signals.coverage_requirement: stable deployer identity plus past-only historical index
signals.adversarial_risk: Fresh deployers and identity rotation reduce recall.
signals.promotion_gate: Implement past-only causal index, measure coverage, preregister hypothesis, then acquire fresh outcomes.
signals.notes: Common in memecoin tooling; not treated as proven edge here.

signals.definition: Causally observed token supply share controlled by deployer/dev-linked addresses.
signals.coverage_requirement: supply snapshot plus defensible dev-linked address mapping
signals.adversarial_risk: Supply can be split across related wallets.
signals.promotion_gate: Collect causally and validate against independent prospective outcomes.
signals.notes: Do not approximate using future holder state.

signals.definition: Concentration of circulating token supply among top holders at decision time.
signals.coverage_requirement: causal holder/supply snapshot with pool/program accounts classified
signals.adversarial_risk: Pool, program and sybil addresses can make naive holder concentration misleading.
signals.promotion_gate: Define exclusions/classification before looking at economic outcomes, then preregister.
signals.notes: No arbitrary top-holder threshold is frozen in V0.

signals.definition: Concentration of early acquired supply/flow among first causal buyers.
signals.coverage_requirement: buyer identities, quantities and causal ordering
signals.adversarial_risk: Related wallets can split buys; definition must distinguish flow from current holdings.
signals.promotion_gate: Implement deterministic feature definition and preregister before evaluating fresh outcomes.
signals.notes: Derivable from richer early-flow evidence; not part of current frozen selector.

signals.definition: Causal evidence that launch participation is concentrated in bundled or linked insider transactions/wallets.
signals.coverage_requirement: bundle/transaction linkage with explicit confidence and causal observation times
signals.adversarial_risk: Linkage heuristics can create false positives and sophisticated actors can evade clustering.
signals.promotion_gate: Define causal linkage method and false-positive audit before preregistration.
signals.notes: Never infer insider status solely from profitability.

signals.definition: Mint/freeze authority configuration causally observed before decision.
signals.coverage_requirement: token program state decoded at or before cutoff
signals.adversarial_risk: Authority state is only one risk dimension and can change later.
signals.promotion_gate: Add deterministic extraction/coverage tests and preregister any exclusion rule.
signals.notes: Safety evidence; not a profitability claim.

signals.definition: Wallet quality computed strictly from activity that was available before the current decision cutoff.
signals.coverage_requirement: versioned historical wallet index with as-of semantics
signals.adversarial_risk: Survivorship bias, address rotation and future-history leakage can manufacture apparent smart money.
signals.promotion_gate: Build point-in-time wallet history and prove no future leakage before any outcome study.
signals.notes: A current all-time wallet PnL must never be joined backward into old opportunities.

signals.definition: Evidence that nominally distinct participants share a causal funding source or funding graph.
signals.coverage_requirement: causal funding edges with entity-resolution confidence
signals.adversarial_risk: Exchanges, relayers and common services can create false clusters.
signals.promotion_gate: Create confidence-aware clustering and benchmark false positives before prospective use.
signals.notes: Useful for detecting fake breadth only after service-address handling is explicit.

signals.definition: Past-only association between current participants/deployer and previously identified rug-like launches.
signals.coverage_requirement: versioned historical labels with label-time provenance
signals.adversarial_risk: Outcome labels created after the current opportunity can leak future information if not point-in-time versioned.
signals.promotion_gate: Prove label-time causality and entity mapping before prospective screening.
signals.notes: Historical labels must carry when they became knowable.

signals.definition: Count of mapped social/event evidence items causally available by the decision cutoff.
signals.coverage_requirement: deduplicated social_event_evidence_v0 rows with token mapping
signals.adversarial_risk: Spam or duplicated sources can inflate raw counts.
signals.promotion_gate: Freeze a Social/Event-First hypothesis independently before fresh outcome acquisition.
signals.notes: published_at is metadata only; it is never the causal availability clock.

signals.definition: Distinct causal source identities supporting an event/token thesis before cutoff.
signals.coverage_requirement: stable source_key plus causal evidence rows
signals.adversarial_risk: Multiple accounts can belong to one coordinated actor.
signals.promotion_gate: Define source-independence rules and preregister separately from Market-First.
signals.notes: Do not conflate account count with independent information.

signals.definition: Source/actor credibility computed only from evidence and outcomes already knowable before the current decision.
signals.coverage_requirement: point-in-time source history with outcome-label availability timestamps
signals.adversarial_risk: Backfilled win rates create severe future leakage and survivorship bias.
signals.promotion_gate: Build point-in-time source history and validate independently before use.
signals.notes: This is where influencer/smart-source quality belongs; follower count alone is not edge.

signals.definition: Whether the causal event contains information not already represented in earlier known evidence for the token/topic.
signals.coverage_requirement: causal content fingerprints/embeddings plus prior-evidence index
signals.adversarial_risk: Paraphrased spam can appear novel without semantic deduplication.
signals.promotion_gate: Freeze a novelty definition before outcome analysis and validate on fresh data.
signals.notes: Content fingerprint exists as evidence metadata; semantic novelty is not yet an established feature.

signals.definition: Whether an executable route can be assembled under the frozen route contract before signing.
signals.coverage_requirement: provider query/assembly under frozen contract
signals.adversarial_risk: Provider state changes quickly and route availability is not market-discovery evidence.
signals.promotion_gate: Keep outside Market-First/Social-First selectors; evaluate only in execution/copyability layer.
signals.notes: Causally usable for execution admission if known before signing, never as a discovery feature.

signals.definition: Provider-reported price impact for the candidate route at execution-admission time.
signals.coverage_requirement: finite provider field under frozen semantics
signals.adversarial_risk: Provider-specific metadata can be missing or unstable.
signals.promotion_gate: Keep outside opportunity selection; preserve frozen +2.0 percentage-point upper bound semantics.
signals.notes: Finite negative values are valid; do not apply abs().

signals.definition: Whether the candidate transaction can be assembled without signing/submission.
signals.coverage_requirement: route provider assembly response
signals.adversarial_risk: Assembly success does not guarantee landing or economically acceptable execution.
signals.promotion_gate: Do not convert route-shadow assembly into a funded execution claim.
signals.notes: Official funded V4 economics remain inconclusive.

signals.definition: Short-horizon stability of independently timestamped causal quotes before signing.
signals.coverage_requirement: multiple causally timestamped provider quotes without delaying beyond policy budget
signals.adversarial_risk: Repeated quoting can itself add latency and stale the opportunity.
signals.promotion_gate: Benchmark latency/copyability trade-off before any admission rule.
signals.notes: Execution research only.

signals.definition: Any route return observed after the decision cutoff, including 5/10/20/30/45/60-second horizons.
signals.coverage_requirement: economic evaluation only
signals.adversarial_risk: Using this in selection is direct target leakage.
signals.promotion_gate: NEVER_PROMOTE_AS_SELECTOR
signals.notes: May label/evaluate a frozen hypothesis, never create its causal input.

signals.definition: PnL from the frozen no-capital route-shadow economic simulation.
signals.coverage_requirement: frozen route-paper contract and aligned artifacts
signals.adversarial_risk: Target leakage plus confusion between route-shadow and landed execution.
signals.promotion_gate: NEVER_PROMOTE_AS_SELECTOR
signals.notes: Route-shadow economics are not realized funded PnL.

signals.definition: Realized funded execution PnL after actual landed execution.
signals.coverage_requirement: landed funded execution evidence
signals.adversarial_risk: Direct future leakage if used as a contemporaneous feature.
signals.promotion_gate: NEVER_PROMOTE_AS_SELECTOR
signals.notes: Official funded V4 economic status remains INCONCLUSIVE.
